note: India Maps formats, tiers from research/families.json (24 Nov 2026). examples: the niche hits each rests on.

formats.name: Every state's ___ on one map
formats.emotion: find my state: every viewer waits for their own
formats.hook: Ask the question over all of India with nothing coloured yet: 'Har state ka official animal kya hai?'
formats.beats: the question over a blank India -> state 1 lights up with its label, then the next, a new state every 1-2 s, in a route across the map (north to south or a loop) -> one surprise state gets a longer beat (the odd one out) -> the last state -> pull back to the whole map filled in -> 'aapka state?' and loop

examples.title: Which Indian State Is Your Favourite Singer From?
The Biggest Empires of Every Indian State

formats.name: India and the world
formats.emotion: pride and surprise: India against the world
formats.hook: One comparison everyone can feel, India on screen at frame 0: 'India se seedha east chalein toh kahan pahunchenge?'
formats.beats: India and the question -> the first country or step -> two more, each bigger or stranger -> the twist -> the payoff fact -> loop

examples.title: Indian ₹500 vs Pakistan vs USA vs Japan vs Nepal

formats.name: How a state was formed or joined
formats.emotion: the satisfaction of a map line finally making sense
formats.hook: Name the state and ask why or how, the state lit on the map: 'Telangana Bharat ka sabse naya rajya kaise bana?'
formats.beats: the state and the question -> the old map before it (one region, one colour) -> the cause, dated -> the line that draws and splits it, or the region that joins -> the year label lands -> the new map, the payoff fact -> loop or 'aapka state kab bana?'

formats.name: A state against a country
formats.hook: A state and a country side by side at frame 0: 'Uttar Pradesh mein Brazil se zyada log?'
formats.beats: the claim -> the state lifted and laid next to the country at the same scale -> the figures on labels, computed -> two more countries it beats -> the payoff -> loop
